packageName.description: npm package name. Default: derived from package.json `name`.

packagePath.description: Path to the package directory containing package.json. Default: project root.

version.description: Version to generate changelog for. Required.

from.description: Previous version to diff from. Optional (uses previous tag).

firstRelease.description: If true, this is the first release. Default: false.

dryRun.description: If true, do not write CHANGELOG.md. Default: false.

commit.description: If true, commit the changelog. Default: false.

branch.description: Branch to target the release. Default: "main".
